data.one_liner: Fine-grained reactivity library for modeling state and business logic in Dart.
data.what_it_does: Exposes core functions and classes to model business logic with fine-grained reactivity, lazy evaluation, and surgical updates. Tracks dependencies automatically and frees them when no longer needed.
use_when: You want fine-grained reactivity without code generation.
You are building business logic that can be shared across Flutter and non-Flutter Dart projects.
avoid_when: You prefer structured architectural patterns like BLoC or standard Provider-based approaches.
You do not want to manage options classes for configuration in version 7.0.0+.
strengths: Lazy evaluation computes values only when read.
Fine-grained tracking prevents unnecessary widget or computation rebuilds.
weaknesses: Requires learning a signals-based mental model.
Breaking changes in 7.0.0 require refactoring constructors and options configurations.

alternatives.name: riverpod
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides compile-safe, robust state management tailored extensively for Flutter applications.

alternatives.name: bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: Enforces strict separation of concerns using events and states with predictable state transitions.

alternatives.name: provider
alternatives.why_pick_it: Simpler, inherited-widget based dependency injection and state propagation.
